pages.text: The fruit seller gave each child one fruit for free. But each child had to choose.
Bung wanted fruit in Ddori's hands. "I will choose for you."
The seller set three fruits before Ddori. "Which do you like?"
Bung answered quickly. "Ddori likes red!" The seller drew back her hand. Bung picked the red fruit and put it before Ddori.
Ddori pushed it with a palm. Away it rolled.
The seller offered three fruits again. Bung answered for Ddori again. "Yellow this time!" Again, her hand drew back.
Ddori pushed yellow away too. Empty hands, closed mouth, head down.
Mom put a finger to Bung's mouth and slid all three fruits before Ddori.
Bung stayed quiet and waited. Ddori's hand moved slowly.
Ddori picked the green fruit and hugged it in both arms. Bung smiled too.
